title: District 5 brush and bulky item collection set for today, Nov. 12
excerpt: Residents can drop off yard waste, old furniture, broken appliances and mattresses from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Santa Maria Avenue and U.S. Highway 83, the City of Laredo said.
content:
The City of Laredo is holding a brush and bulky item collection for District 5 today, Thursday, Nov. 12, from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Santa Maria Avenue and U.S. Highway 83, under the overpass.

Residents can bring tree branches, old furniture, broken appliances, mattresses and other bulky items, according to the city.

Household trash, construction debris, hazardous materials, tires and electronics will not be accepted, the city said.

For more information, residents can call 3-1-1 or 956-796-1000.

Source: City of Laredo, Nov. 11, 2026.
